source.title: Competitor knocked over cover while setting up camera
source.content:
DISCLAIMER: This has seen been updated with regulation [A2e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/#A2e2), to more clearly define how this kind of incident should be handled

A competitor accidentally knocked over the cube cover while setting up their camera. Incidents like this are ruled as DNFs (not DNS's). The ruling is determined as such because it is the fault of the competitor that they are seeing their cube early.

translation.title: 选手设置摄像头时碰倒魔方罩
translation.content:
说明：此后规则 [A2e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/#A2e2) 已更新，更明确地规定此类事件的处理方式。

一名选手设置摄像头时意外碰倒魔方罩。此类情况判为 DNF，而非 DNS，因为选手提前看见自己的魔方是由其自身过错造成。
